entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: You want to know about anarchy? You don't tell me where that other bomb is, I'll make sure you spend your prison time... Putting a big smile on some convict's face.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Son of a bitch stole it, truck and all. Some storage garage.
entries.speaker: Mayhew
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Where?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Terma, north dakota.
entries.speaker: Mayhew
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Thank you. Scully, get on the phone and get the license numbers... For any two-ton trucks stolen in north dakota in the last six months. Then call canadian border authorities... And have them stop any vehicle fitting that description. Tell them they're looking for a bomb.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: This has been a big setup from the beginning, almost perfectly executed. Someone used Krycek, then Krycek used us. Someone who didn't want that rock in american hands.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: But what's in canada?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Where would you put this rock if you didn't want it to be found?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Back in the ground.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: FEDERAL CORRECTIONAL FACILITY, NEW YORK CITY

entries.text: Fertilizer. Fertilizer for my hothouse tomatoes. Beautiful tomatoes, all year, eh? Thanks.
entries.speaker: Peskow

entries.text: Go back to the refinery. See if you can find anybody that knows anything about that truck.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ alarm beeping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I would just as soon kill you, but please don't make me. My work is done.
entries.speaker: Peskow

entries.text: [ speaking russian ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ gavel pounds ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I'd like to get started here. Miss Scully?
entries.speaker: Chairman Romine

entries.text: Yes, I'm ready here, sir.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You have evidence to present. This is what I've been told.
entries.speaker: Chairman Romine

entries.text: Yes, sir. Uh-- evidence linking a number of deaths, a great number, to a biotoxin that was transported to u.s. Soil... By a courier who was also killed.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: This was the man who was pushed from the assistant director's apartment?
entries.speaker: Senator Sorenson

entries.text: Yes. He has not been ID'd.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Do we have the name of the individual who pushed him?
entries.speaker: Senator Sorenson

entries.text: Yes, sir. Alex Krycek, who is missing and possibly deceased.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And are you then in possession of the pouch or its contents?
entries.speaker: Senator Sorenson

entries.text: No, sir.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What evidence are you then presenting us with today?
entries.speaker: Senator Sorenson

entries.text: Documents and interviews... In support of a wide-ranging conspiracy... To control a lethal biotoxin... That is, in fact, extraterrestrial.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What are we talking about, little green men here?
entries.speaker: Senator Sorenson

entries.text: No, sir. Not at all.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Why is this so hard to believe... When the accepted discovery of life off this planet... Is on the front page of every newspaper around the world? When even the most conservative scientists and science journals... Are calling for the exploration of mars and jupiter? With every reason to believe that life and the persistence of it... Is thriving outside our own terrestrial sphere? If you cannot get past this, then I suggest that this whole committee be held in contempt... For ignoring evidence that cannot be refuted.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: This is not why we are here today.
entries.speaker: Senator Sorenson

entries.text: Then why are we here today?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I will suggest that we recess here until the evidence can be properly evaluated.
entries.speaker: Chairman Romine
